documents.text: The pipeline splits long documents into retrieval sized chunks for offline search.
Every artifact is content addressed and can be replayed inside a fresh container.
BM25 ranking rewards rare terms and penalizes very common words across the corpus.
The completion gate refuses any success that lacks a clean room replay proof.
Offline chunking never calls an external embedding service or a remote api.
A frozen contract states the goal before any agent action happens at all.
Chunk offsets must slice back into the source text exactly for every record.
Retrieval quality depends on tokenization choices and consistent lowercasing rules.
本地 检索 流水线 支持 中文 语料 的 离线 排序 与 审计 replay .
The ledger tracks requirement coverage without granting any acceptance knowledge.
